title: Migration Without Data Profiling
summary: Migration mappings are designed from documentation and schema only, without profiling the actual source data.
body_markdown:
# Migration Without Data Profiling

## Problem

Mappings assume documented behaviour; actual data contains undocumented codes, overloaded fields and invalid combinations.

## Symptoms

- Load failures late in the project; manual fix lists; reconciliation that never balances.

## Root Causes

- Schedule pressure; source access restrictions; overconfidence in documentation.

## Consequences

- Delays, data loss, corrupted history in the target.

## Detection

- No profiling results linked to mapping specifications.

## Remediation

- Profile early (value distributions, nulls, patterns, referential integrity); revise mappings; add [[Data Quality Gate|quality gates]] to rehearsals.

## Alternative Patterns

[[Phased Data Migration]] (learning between waves), [[Big Bang Data Migration]] with repeated rehearsals.

## When It May Be Acceptable

Tiny, fully understood data sets.
